metadata.suite: Project Rakshak 2.0 Multi-Temporal Change Detection Benchmark (Held-Out Seeds 21-60)
metadata.coregistration_method: ORB (2500 kp) + RANSAC Affine with Phase Correlation Fallback
metadata.stability_filter_rule: Report change only if conf >= 0.40 in appearing scene AND no detection of same class within 28px in partner scene at conf >= 0.15
metadata.operational_isolation: Strictly isolated from operational threat scoring table

detector_flicker_unchanged.description: Detector flicker on unedited objects present in both scenes (partner conf below 0.25 floor)

inpainting_artifacts.description: Hallucinated detections at inpainting patch boundaries where objects were removed or moved

misregistration_texture_noise.description: Residual sub-pixel displacement noise and unassociated background textures

honest_failure_analysis: 1. Detector Flicker on Unchanged Objects (75.29% of FPs): Targets present in both scenes with marginal detection confidence hovering around 0.25 trigger 128 false-positive change alerts in raw mode across seeds 21-60.
2. Inpainting Boundary Artifacts (20.59% of FPs): Telea inpainting on natural terrain creates high-frequency texture steps responsible for 35 false detections in raw mode.

3. Operational Trade-Off with Stability Filter: The frozen stability filter suppresses 166 of 170 False Positives (97.6% reduction down to 4 FPs), yielding 80.95% pooled precision (17/21 TP/FP), while recall contracts to 14.17% (17/120 TP/FN).
4. Sub-Pixel Co-Registration Resilience: Across misalignments up to 8.0 px, mean registration error remains 0.1449 ± 0.1034 px.
